extracted.name: Fajita Soup
extracted.description: This Chicken Fajita Soup recipe couldn't be easier to make and it's healthy too, with veggies, beans, corn, and chicken in a flavorful broth.
ingredient_lines: 14.5 ounce can diced tomatoes with green chilies
1 chipotle chili in adobo sauce PLUS 1 Tablespoon sauce from the can ((or more, for more heat))
salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts (, or add leftover cooked chicken (like rotisserie) at the end)
15 ounce can black beans (, drained and rinsed)
instruction_lines: Add olive oil to a soup pot over medium heat. Once hot (but not smoking) add onion and bell pepper and sauté for a few minutes. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add diced tomatoes, chipotle chili and adobo sauce, cumin, oregano, chili powder, paprika, salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Add chicken and broth cook over medium heat until chicken is cooked through. Remove chicken to a plate and shred with forks.
Add black beans and corn to the pot and cook until warmed. Return shredded chicken to the pot. Taste and add additional seasonings, if needed.
Serve topped with avocado and cilantro, and tortillas on the side, if desired.
